Anya K.: quick copy pass for the Delete Model confirmation in Console — want a few eyes on tone + accessibility. current dialog below, plus 3 alt options. any red flags? Anya K.: Current (live): ``` Title: Delete model Body: Are you sure you want to delete this model? This action cannot be undone. Primary button: Delete model Secondary: Cancel ``` Matt R.: sounds standard. main thing is making it clear whether metrics/serving configs are also removed. do we mention that? Anya K.: good call — backend removes versions and endpoints. thinking we should be explicit so users don’t accidentally lose infra. Anya K.: Proposed variants: ``` A — Clear & direct: Title: Permanently delete model Body: Deleting this model will remove all saved versions and endpoints. This cannot be undone. Primary: Permanently delete Secondary: Cancel B — Softer, product-y: Title: Remove model from Redwood Body: This will delete the model and any associated endpoints. You can re-upload later, but historical metrics will be lost. Primary: Remove model Secondary: Keep model C — Action + recovery focus: Title: Delete model and endpoints Body: This deletes the model and its endpoints. If you need the data later, contact support; we may be able to assist. Primary: Delete model Secondary: Cancel ``` Kevin L.: I prefer A for clarity. B feels vague and might make someone think data is restorable. C ok but mentioning support could create expectation of recovery — risky. Lucy P.: Accessibility notes: make sure the primary button has descriptive aria-label (e.g., "Permanently delete model ") and add an aria-live="polite" status announcing the action started. Also keyboard: ESC should close dialog, and focus should return to the model row after close. Anya K.: yes on ARIA. what about the title wording — "Permanently delete" vs "Delete model" — which reads better for screen readers? DesignBot: recommendation: use simple verb-first phrasing. "Permanently delete model" reads more explicit in assistive tech. Suggested aria-labels: ```html
Deleting model…
``` Matt R.: also add a small help link under the body: "What happens when I delete a model?" that opens docs in a new tab — reduces support tickets. Kevin L.: tiny nit: primary button text should be short but include the word "permanently" for legal clarity. agree with Matt on help link. Anya K.: updated combined copy (taking A + ARIA + help link): ``` Title: Permanently delete model Body: Deleting this model will remove all saved versions and endpoints. This action cannot be undone. Small link: What happens when I delete a model? Primary: Permanently delete Secondary: Cancel ARIA notes: primary button aria-label="Permanently delete model "; role="status" region shows "Deleting model…"; focus returns to model list on close. ESC closes dialog. ``` Lucy P.: LGTM. also check contrast on the destructive button (red) and add focus visible ring for keyboard users. Matt R.: if legal needs stronger phrasing we can add a second confirmation step (type model name) for high-risk orgs, but default flow should stay single confirm to avoid friction. Anya K.: great — I'll push variant A copy + ARIA markup to the modal component PR and add the help link. thanks all :sparkles: Kevin L.: thanks — quick follow-up: can we standardize the phrase across Delete + Stop Rollout flows? I'll open a tiny doc to sync language. Anya K.: yes please. I'll drop examples from this thread there. DesignBot: note saved to /docs/ui-copy/delete-confirmation-guidance (auto).
